lines.text: Ben walked hills for a month before his big park hike,
On trip day it held water, food and warm layers,
and after two miles it felt like a brick.
Here's the fix. Train with the pack you will carry.
Add a little weight each week, like one more water bottle.
Then do one long dress rehearsal hike before the trip.
This time the climb felt normal.
Save this before your next training walk.
